checkpoints: Digest-addressed raw content is stored once outside catalog metadata and is not rewritten by metadata-only mutations.
Version 1 embedded catalogs migrate to version 2 without changing the logical assets or revision.
Version 2 reopen fails closed for missing, corrupt, or digest-mismatched content.
Create-tag and association scopes are snapshotted before queued work.
Pre-rename failures leave memory unchanged and clean blobs created by the failed mutation; post-rename directory-sync failures reconcile memory to committed disk before surfacing the error.

verification.command: npm run build -w @relayer/visual-assets && npx vitest run packages/visual-assets/test/visual-assets.test.ts

limits: Crash-orphan garbage collection is deferred because the catalog has no explicit cross-instance ownership lock; eager reopen cleanup could delete an in-flight writer's blob.
Concurrent multi-writer catalog mutation is outside the current single-owner production contract.
Metadata candidates still reconstruct and validate the in-memory library, so this change removes repeated durable byte storage and writes but does not remove in-memory decoding cost.
